title: Black Friday Video Ads From One Photo | AIVideosUGC
description: Make a Black Friday video ad from one product photo and add your discount as an editable overlay. 9:16 or 1:1 clips for Facebook and Instagram.
h1: Black Friday Video Ads Ready for Your Deal
lead: Black Friday rewards sellers who show up with ads early, but filming a fresh deal clip at the last minute is impossible when offers are still changing. Lock the video now from one product photo, then type the confirmed discount on top later.

steps.d: Start with one clear photo of the product featured in the Black Friday offer.
Share the review, try-on, unboxing or demo moment in one sentence.
Add the confirmed discount, code and end date in your editor.

faq.q: Which product photo should I upload?
faq.a: Choose a sharp photo of the item you plan to feature and keep the whole product inside the frame.

faq.q: When should I add the discount?
faq.a: Add the final price, code, and sale dates as text after those details are set.

faq.q: Can I use the same video on a store page?
faq.a: Use the same featured product in the video and the destination page so the offer feels connected.

faq.q: How long should a Black Friday offer clip be?
faq.a: Six seconds works for a single price beat; 10 to 15 seconds gives room for the product and the offer. The costs are 24, 40, or 60 credits.

faq.q: Can I change the offer after the ad is approved?
faq.a: Edit the editable text layer in your ad platform. Keeping the deal text separate from the video means the same clip can carry an updated price.

faq.q: Can the video include the discount burned in?
faq.a: Keep the percentage and dates as a text layer you add after download, so every number stays exact.

faq.q: How do I keep a Black Friday claim accurate?
faq.a: Keep the generated scene neutral, then add only the confirmed percentage, price, code, end date, and stock wording in your editor.

faq.q: Can the creator show a face or only hands?
faq.a: Use a face for a creator review or try-on; use hands for a gift reveal and product demo when the item or hinge needs the close-up.

faq.q: Which shot works for a gift reveal?
faq.a: Use an overhead or three-quarter frame with the full gift item and box visible, then leave open space for the offer layer.
Choose 9:16 for Stories and Reels; choose 1:1 for a feed or listing when the product and offer need equal space.

faq.q: What should I remove after the event?
faq.a: Remove or update the discount, code, countdown, and end date after the event; the reusable product action can stay if its wording remains accurate.

faq.q: Can I make the video before I know my discount?
faq.a: Yes. Generate the clip with empty space for the offer, then add the confirmed discount, code and end date as editable text, so creative is finished early without a reshoot.

faq.q: Can these clips run as paid Black Friday ads?
faq.a: Yes. Videos you make can be used in your own paid campaigns on Facebook, Instagram and other channels, and downloads have no watermark. Remove or pause the ads when the event ends.
